import pytest
from eab.construction import norm_rational
def helper(q:float):
    r=q
    with pytest.raises(type(ZeroDivisionError())):
        r=q*q
        unused=1//0
        r=q
    return r
def bad(q:float):
    return norm_rational((helper(q),helper(q)))
